nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a real inner product space of positive finite dimension, viewed as a Riemannian manifold with the metric given by its inner product, and let $a, c \in \mathbb{R}$. The function $f(x) = \frac{a}{2} \|x\|^2$ on $F$ is a gradient Ricci soliton with constant $c$ if and only if $a = c$.
nodes.title: Gaussian potentials that are gradient Ricci solitons

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a finite-dimensional real inner product space, viewed as a Riemannian manifold with the metric given by its inner product, and let $a \in \mathbb{R}$. The function $f(x) = \frac{a}{2} \|x\|^2$ on $F$ is a gradient Ricci soliton with constant $a$.
nodes.title: The Gaussian gradient Ricci soliton

nodes.summary: Let $M$ be a smooth manifold (possibly with boundary or corners) modelled on a finite-dimensional real normed space, with a smooth Riemannian metric $g$. nodes.title: Gradient Ricci soliton

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a real inner product space of positive finite dimension, viewed as a Riemannian manifold with the metric given by its inner product, and let $a, c \in \mathbb{R}$. The function $f(x) = \frac{a}{2} \|x\|^2$ on $F$ is a gradient shrinking Ricci soliton with constant $c$ if and only if $a = c$ and $c > 0$.
nodes.title: Gaussian potentials that are gradient shrinking Ricci solitons

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a finite-dimensional real inner product space, viewed as a Riemannian manifold with the metric given by its inner product, and let $a > 0$. The function $f(x) = \frac{a}{2} \|x\|^2$ on $F$ is a gradient shrinking Ricci soliton with constant $a$.
nodes.title: The Gaussian shrinking soliton

nodes.summary: On a Riemannian manifold $(M, g)$, a function $f : M \to \mathbb{R}$ and a constant $c \in \mathbb{R}$ form a gradient shrinking Ricci soliton if they form a gradient Ricci soliton and $c > 0$.
nodes.title: Gradient shrinking Ricci soliton

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
